paragraphs.source_en: Senhime began to sense the unrest within Osaka Castle after Tokugawa Ieyasu moved to Sunpu. She was just coming of age and had begun to feel something new for her husband, Toyotomi Hideyori.

units.source_en: Senhime began to sense the unrest within Osaka Castle after Tokugawa Ieyasu moved to Sunpu.
units.source_zh: 千姬对大坂城内人心浮动有所察觉，乃是从德川家康迁居骏府始。

units.source_en: She was just coming of age and had begun to feel something new for her husband, Toyotomi Hideyori.
units.source_zh: 她正值妙龄，已对夫君丰臣秀赖生起异样的情感。

paragraphs.source_zh: 千姬对大坂城内人心浮动有所察觉，乃是从德川家康迁居骏府始。她正值妙龄，已对夫君丰臣秀赖生起异样的情感。

paragraphs.source_en: In the past, Senhime had often seen her sixth uncle, Tadateru. Secretly comparing Hideyori with Tadateru, she found Hideyori far nobler and more handsome. In dignity and bearing, however, Hideyori still fell short of Tadateru. This inevitably left Senhime somewhat uneasy and dissatisfied. What troubled her most were the stories of how her grandfather, now retired in Sunpu, was training her three young uncles, including Gorotamaru.

paragraphs.source_en: Gorotamaru, the seventh son, had been born in the fifth year of Keichō. Chōfukumaru was the eighth son and only six years old that year. The youngest, Tsuruchiyo, was only five. That spring, Lady Okatsu had adopted him, and he was already lord of Shimotsuma in Hitachi, with an annual domain income of one hundred thousand koku.

paragraphs.source_zh: 五郎太丸生于庆长五年，排行第七。长福丸排行第八，今年只六岁。末子鹤千代年仅五岁，当年春天被阿胜夫人收为养子，已为常陆下妻年俸十万石的领主。

paragraphs.source_en: Though already a lord, Tsuruchiyo still lived in Sunpu with his adoptive mother, Lady Okatsu, and his two elder brothers, Gorotamaru and Chōfukumaru. Eight-year-old Gorotamaru had inherited the former Kiyosu fief of his late brother Tadakichi, Governor of Shimotsuke, and was soon to become lord of Owari. Chōfukumaru, too, would inherit the former territory of Nobuyoshi, who had died in the eighth year of Keichō, becoming lord of Mito in Hitachi with an annual domain income of two hundred and fifty thousand koku.

paragraphs.source_en: Senhime had little interest in these matters, yet she could not remain indifferent to her three uncles. Since none of the three could yet ride to a hawking field, Ieyasu specially selected sturdy attendants to carry them there for training.
